Synopsis:
King Charles, Queen Camilla, French President Macron and UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham visited the Bayeux Tapestry exhibition at the British Museum. The nearly 1,000-year-old tapestry has been loaned to Britain for the first time since its creation, as a symbol of strengthened UK-France relations post-Brexit. The exhibition opens to the public September 10 and runs through July next year; first-batch tickets have already sold out, generating ~£2.5M.
